turns.text: [shouting over the engine roar] AND WE ARE LIVE at the Gold Coast! [fast, breathless] The Boost Mobile Gold Coast 500, the Surfers Paradise street circuit, and the Coates twenty-six is out there FLYING! [building] But before a single Supercar turned a wheel — this place had to be BUILT. [punchy] This is the story of the team that built it!

[rapid] Six weeks! From the first truck through the gate on the seventh of September — to the chequered flag this weekend! [fast] Buildings, toilets, generators, lights, water barriers, fencing — thousands of pieces, hundreds of loads, one crew! [shouting] And they got it DONE!

[race-caller, warm] Leading the Coates effort on site — the project manager, Andrew Fisher! [fast] Thirty-six days on the ground by race day, three hundred and eighty-five hours — the plan from the branch, the trucks on the road, the people on the tools, all of it running through him!

[race-caller, naming them like the grid] The install team! Aaron Zelvis! Alfie Harris! Kyle Gover! Daniel Gough! Jayden Paul! Wayne Crimmin! [punchy] And on the race weekend — Ludwig Chee on the tools and Frank Devilles on the power! [shouting] THAT is the crew!

[fast, proud] Aaron — thirty-five days, three hundred and ninety-six hours! Alfie — twenty-seven days! Daniel — twenty! Kyle — twenty-one! [building] Nearly two thousand hours of Coates hands on this circuit by Sunday night — [shouting] and every one of them counts!

[driving, over the engine] FIFTY-TWO buildings! [rapid] Twenty-three six-metre offices, fourteen four-point-eights, six twelve-metre buildings, three nine-point-sixes, ticket boxes, containers, a cool room! [fast] First one on the ground the thirteenth of September — the last one in place the fourteenth of October!

[rapid-fire, naming them] Team offices for every garage in pit lane — Triple Eight! DJR! Walkinshaw! Grove! Erebus! Brad Jones! Matt Stone! PremiAir! Blanchard! Team Eighteen! [fast] The Event Control Centre, race medical, the police command post, ambulance, fire, first aid, security, accreditation, the ticket boxes at the gates — [shouting] all of it Coates!

[fast, pointing] And not one of them just dropped and left! [punchy] Fifty-two buildings positioned and LEVELLED! Forty-five sets of stairs set, checked, ticked! [building] Thirty-one days start to finish — [shouting] every building closed off on the record!

[excited] Now the big number! TWO HUNDRED AND SIXTY-FIVE toilets! [rapid] Two hundred and thirty-six fresh-water-flush units! Fifteen six-metre blocks! Two sixteen-pan blocks! Accessible units! Two trailers! [fast] Across seventy-four locations from the pit paddock to the far end of Main Beach!

[driving] First ones in on the fourteenth of September — the last one signed off on the twentieth of October! [fast] And on every race night, every single one of them pumped, cleaned, restocked and signed off with its own QR code — [shouting] two hundred and sixty-six units, fifteen areas, three nights straight!

[rapid] Twenty-four variable message boards! [fast] Every single one towed around the track, set in its location and switched on — every rego and fleet number on the record! [driving] Fourteen generators — two two-hundred-kVA sets with cables, a one-fifty, four sixties, fifties, forty-fives, thirties, twenties — [shouting] the power behind the whole precinct, all in, all running!

[fast] Seven light towers! Thirty trakmats! Forklifts — two-and-a-half tonne, three-and-a-half, five tonne rough terrain! [punchy] A forty-three-foot scissor lift, a sixty-foot straight boom, a sixty-one-foot knuckle boom — [shouting] every machine that put this place together, ON SITE!

[serious, driving] And the ones that keep people SAFE! [rapid] Three hundred and eleven crash-rated, water-filled Armorzone barriers — every one of them placed! [fast] The Gold Coast Highway — Tedder Avenue, Turn Two, the Macintosh Park turning lane — a hundred and fifty-four of them along the grandstands alone! Main Beach Parade! Admiralty Drive! Helen Park! Commodore Park! The Turn Eleven run-off!

[fast] Three hundred and eleven barriers — more than six hundred metres of them, two metres at a time — [building] first ones placed the fourteenth of September, the last ones set three days out from the flag! [shouting] Hostile-vehicle protection, grandstand protection, racing kerbs — one hundred per cent, DONE!

[rapid, commentating] And the trucks! Thirty delivery days! [fast] The biggest, the sixteenth of October — twenty-five references through the gate in ONE DAY! [building] Every load tracked, every arrival timed, every delivery landed — [shouting] that is a record you can stand on!

[driving, over the engine] And now the one that stretches the WHOLE LAP! [race-caller, naming them] Wayne Woods leads the Advanced Temporary Fencing crew — Owen Cowell McPaul! Daniel Macleod! Cody Woods! Chase Hireni! Tahi Peni! Daniel Smith! Scott Hildebrand! Hayden McAvoy! [shouting] Give them a ROAR!

[fast, building] TWELVE POINT SIX KILOMETRES of temporary fence standing! [punchy] Twelve thousand six hundred and seventeen metres — [fast] complete, to the schedule, from the ninth of September right through to race week! [shouting] More than a hundred and twenty dockets — every one of them checked!

[rapid-fire] More than four and a half thousand panels! [fast] Nearly seven thousand feet! More than two hundred concrete blocks! [building] Every panel carried, stood, clamped and checked by hand — [shouting] foot by foot, around the whole circuit — COMPLETE!

[fast] More than six and a half thousand clamps! More than a thousand braces! [punchy] A hundred and thirty-five vehicle gates! Thirty-four pedestrian gates! [fast] Every gate hung, every wheel on, every one of them swinging — [shouting] the small pieces, the BIG effort!

[driving] Then the crowd control! [rapid] Seven point four kilometres of crowd-control barrier! [fast] Two point two on the event lines — five point two of demarcation — [building] more than two thousand three hundred barrier units, plus the flat-feet runs where the ground said so — [shouting] every section in, every section standing!

[fast] And the work you do TWICE! [rapid] Four point four kilometres of scrim fitted along the fence lines! [fast] Nearly a kilometre of fence relocated when the plan moved — [building] every move on a docket, every metre back up and standing — [shouting] fence that MOVES with the event!

[punchy] Corporate! Pit lane! The paddock! Main Beach! The Esplanade! The compounds! [fast] Every docket linked to the area it went in — [building] so when the record says a run is standing, [shouting] it is standing exactly where the drawings say!

[fast, summing up] Put the fence and the crowd control together — twenty kilometres of work around the precinct, complete, to the schedule — [building] every run standing where the drawings say! [shouting] Wayne's crew — DONE, and done right!

[sincere, fast] Pre-starts every morning! Loads walked round, spotters called, clearances checked! [rapid] Ground that shifts, levels, stairs, access — forklift, hands and judgement! [building] Nearly two thousand hours of Coates labour by race weekend — [shouting] every pre-start signed, every load spotted, every lift called!

[fast] Thirty days with trucks through the gate! Twenty-six days of fencing dockets! [punchy] Every date on the record — the thirteenth of September, the sixteenth of October, the twentieth, the twenty-first — [shouting] it all happened, and it is all written down!

[laughing, lighter] And the weather tried its best! [fast] Thirty-three days on the Bureau's archive from the seventh of September — eight wet mornings, nearly twenty millimetres of rain! [rapid] Fog on the twelfth of September, fog again on the sixth of October — [building] a sixty-three-kilometre-an-hour gust on the seventh!

[fast, warm] Coolest morning twelve-point-nine degrees on the twenty-seventh of September — warmest day twenty-eight-point-six on the twenty-first! [punchy] And they built through all of it — [shouting] rain, fog, wind, sun, and showers forecast for race week!

[proud, over the roar] Buildings — one hundred per cent! Toilets — one hundred per cent! Generators, lights, machines — one hundred per cent! [fast] Water barriers — every one placed! Boards — all twenty-four set! Fence and crowd control — complete, to the schedule! [shouting] The GC five hundred precinct, BUILT, by Coates!

[punchy, one at a time] Care Deeply! Customer Focused! Be Our Best! One Team! Competitive Spirit! [driving] Those are the Coates values — [fast] and for six weeks on this circuit you could SEE them — in a careful move, a clear call, a mate with a hand out!

[race-caller, naming them] Andrew Fisher! Aaron Zelvis! Alfie Harris! Kyle Gover! Daniel Gough! Jayden Paul! Wayne Crimmin! Ludwig Chee! Frank Devilles! [fast] Wayne Woods and the whole Advanced fencing crew! [building] The branch behind them — [shouting] THIS is the team that made it happen!
[the roar dropping away, sincere, slow and quiet] And every one of them... deserves... to be recognised.
[lifting again, into the engine, fast] Stay with us! [shouting] Another lap with the Coates twenty-six — and another look at the people who built the GC five hundred!

[energetic, shouting over the engine] Back LIVE with the Coates twenty-six on the Gold Coast! [fast] Just joining us — this is the crew that built the GC five hundred, from the first truck to the chequered flag! [shouting] Here is how they did it!

revised: 22 Oct 2026: turns 11, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23 and 28 re-voiced to speak as complete (fence and crowd control to the schedule, no demob; 311 barriers all placed; 24 boards all towed and set). Other turns and takes unchanged from v11.11.
